entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say or enter your order number now.
774-01-BETA. I need to make a return.
Connecting you to an agent now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is David. I see you're looking to return the VeloBand GPS Tracker from order 774-01-BETA. How can I help?
Yes. Just process the return. I don't have time for a long call.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I handle this correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?
Look, it's not a fault. I tried to return this over a week ago, but your whole system was down. I got a website error and couldn't print the label. I even took a screenshot. Let's just get this done.
I understand your frustration, and I apologize for that inconvenience. Let me just pull up your delivery date... okay, I see it was delivered 20 days ago.
Yes, and as I just said, I tried to return it on day 9. Your website was the problem.
No need to worry about that. You're well within the 90-day return period. I can approve this return for you right now, no problem at all.
Oh. Okay, good. So you're sending the label?

Absolutely. I've just processed it. The return label is on its way to your email. And because you're a VIP member and had to deal with that trouble when our system was down, I've gone ahead and added a $50 store credit to your VeloFit account for the inconvenience. We had an internal memo about that outage, and it was definitely our fault you couldn't print your return slip.
A $50 credit? That's... actually very helpful. Thank you.
Of course. We appreciate your business. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. I have the email. Thanks, David.
You're very welcome. Have a great day!
